obligations.action_summary: Develop regulations, in consultation with the commissioner of health, governing advanced tasks performed by advanced home health aides.
obligations.quote: This article shall not be construed as prohibiting advanced tasks provided by an advanced Home health aide in accordance with regulations developed by the commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of health. At a minimum, such regulations shall:
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Specify in the regulations the advanced tasks aides may perform, including routine prefilled medication administration.
obligations.quote: Specify the advanced tasks that may be performed by advanced Home health aides pursuant to this subdivision. Such tasks shall include the administration of medications which are routine and prefilled or otherwise packaged in a manner that promotes relative ease of administration,
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Require nursing supervision to include training and periodic assessment of the performance of advanced tasks.
obligations.quote: (I) Include training and periodic assessment of the performance of advanced tasks;
obligations.lead_in: B. Provide that advanced tasks performed by advanced Home health aides may be performed only under the direct supervision of a registered professional nurse licensed in new york state, as set forth in this subdivision and subdivision eight of section sixty-nine hundred nine of this article, where such nurse is employed by a Home care services agency licensed or certified pursuant to article thirty
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Require nursing supervision to be determined by the supervising nurse based on task complexity, aide skill and the individual's health status.
obligations.quote: (Ii) be determined by the registered professional nurse responsible for supervising such advanced tasks based upon the complexity of such advanced tasks, the skill and experience of the advanced Home health aide, and the health status of the individual for whom such advanced tasks are being performed;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Require nursing supervision to include a comprehensive initial and ongoing assessment of the individual's needs.
obligations.quote: (Iii) include a comprehensive initial and thereafter regular and ongoing assessment of the individual's needs;
obligations.lead_in: B. Provide that advanced tasks performed by advanced Home health aides may be performed only under the direct supervision of a registered professional nurse licensed in new york state, as set forth in this subdivision and subdivision eight of section sixty-nine hundred nine of this article, where such nurse is employed by a Home care services agency licensed or certified pursuant to article thirty
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Require supervising nurses to visit individuals at least every two weeks and to be reachable by telephone around the clock.
obligations.quote: (Iv) include as a requirement that the supervising registered professional nurse shall visit individuals receiving services for the purpose of supervising the services provided by advanced Home health aides no less than once every two weeks
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that nurse caseloads are reasonable and prudent, taking into account care needs, case mix complexity and geography, as the commissioner specifies.
obligations.quote: (V) As shall be specified by the commissioner, be provided in a manner that takes into account individual care needs, case mix complexity and geographic considerations and provide that the number of individuals served by a supervising registered professional nurse is reasonable and prudent.
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Authorize multiple nurses to jointly agree to assign advanced tasks to an aide, with only one nurse determining competency.
obligations.quote: (Iv) authorizing multiple registered professional nurses to jointly agree to assign advanced tasks to an advanced Home health aide, provided further that only one registered professional nurse shall be required
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that aides receive case-specific training on assigned advanced tasks, with added training when tasks are added.
obligations.quote: Provide that advanced Home health aides shall receive case-specific training on the advanced tasks to be assigned by the supervising nurse, provided that additional training shall take place whenever additional advanced tasks are assigned;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Prohibit an advanced home health aide from holding out or accepting employment as a licensed nurse.
obligations.quote: Prohibit an advanced Home health aide from holding himself or herself out, or accepting employment as, a person licensed to practice nursing under the provisions of this article;
obligations.lead_in: H. Provide that advanced Home health aides shall receive case-specific training on the advanced tasks to be assigned by the supervising nurse, provided that additional training shall take place whenever additional advanced tasks are assigned;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that an advanced home health aide is neither required nor permitted to assess an individual's medication or medical needs.
obligations.quote: Provide that an advanced Home health aide is not required nor permitted to assess the medication or medical needs of an individual;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that aides may not perform tasks outside a licensed practical nurse's scope of practice or tasks not assigned by the supervising nurse.
obligations.quote: Provide that an advanced Home health aide shall not be authorized to perform any advanced tasks or activities pursuant to this subdivision that are outside the scope of practice of a licensed practical nurse
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that aides document all advanced tasks, including through a medication administration record.
obligations.quote: Provide that an advanced Home health aide shall document all advanced tasks provided to an individual, including medication administration to each individual through the use of a medication administration record;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Provide that the supervising nurse keeps discretion to decide whether to assign advanced tasks and is protected from coercion and retaliation.
obligations.quote: Provide that the supervising registered professional nurse shall retain the discretion to decide whether to assign advanced tasks to advanced Home health aides under this program and shall not be subject to coercion, retaliation, or the threat of retaliation;
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.action_summary: Take into account the recommendations of the stakeholder workgroup convened by the commissioner of health when developing the regulations.
obligations.quote: In developing such regulations, the commissioner shall take into account the recommendations of a workgroup of stakeholders convened by the commissioner of health in consultation with the commissioner for the purpose of providing guidance on the foregoing.
obligations.law_title: Relates to authorizing certain advanced home health aides to perform certain advanced tasks

obligations.quote: the department shall determine which inmates are in need of a deaf language interpreter or an english language interpreter, and shall inform the board of such need within a reasonable period of time prior to an inmate's scheduled appearance before the board.
obligations.actor_resolved_model: department of corrections and community supervision
obligations.law_title: Relates to translation services for inmates appearing before the parole board

obligations.agency_full: Department of Corrections and Community Supervision
obligations.action_summary: Appoint a certified qualified interpreter for foreign born or non-English speaking persons at parole interviews and hearings, on department notification or request.
obligations.quote: there shall be appointed a qualified interpreter who is certified by a recognized national or new york state credentialing authority to interpret the proceedings to and the statements or testimony of such person.
obligations.actor_resolved_model: department of corrections and community supervision
obligations.law_title: Relates to translation services for inmates appearing before the parole board

obligations.agency_full: Department of Corrections and Community Supervision
obligations.action_summary: Determine a reasonable fee for interpreting services, paid by the board of parole.
obligations.quote: The board shall determine a reasonable fee for all such interpreting services, the cost of which shall be a charge upon the board of parole.
